mapper.select: SELECT * FROM club_member WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT cm.*, u.username, c.name as club_name FROM club_member cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN club c ON cm.club_id = c.id WHERE cm.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY cm.join_date DESC
SELECT cm.*, u.username, c.name as club_name FROM club_member cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN club c ON cm.club_id = c.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cm.join_date DESC
SELECT cm.*, u.username, c.name as club_name FROM club_member cm LEFT JOIN user u ON cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN club c ON cm.club_id = c.id WHERE cm.status = #{status} ORDER BY cm.join_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_member (club_id, user_id, status, join_date, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{joinDate}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE club_member SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM club_member WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND user_id = #{userId}
